en.title: Drug operation in 3 provinces: 11 suspects arrested
en.summary: Following a three-month investigation coordinated by the Aydın Chief Public Prosecutor's Office, simultaneous operations were conducted at 63 addresses across Aydın, Muğla, and Denizli provinces.

stories.title: Aydın merkezli uyuşturucu operasyonu: 111 şüpheliden 11'i tutuklandı

en.title: Drug operation centered in Aydın: 11 of 111 suspects arrested
en.summary: A drug operation spanning three provinces resulted in 111 suspects being detained, with 11 of them arrested following the operation centered in Aydın.

en.title: 3 journalists to give statements in fund investigation
en.summary: The Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's Office has summoned three journalists to provide statements regarding their public comments related to a fund investigation.

stories.title: Afyonkarahisar Vali Yardımcısı hayatını kaybetti: Silahla vurulmuş halde bulunmuştu

en.title: Afyonkarahisar Deputy Governor dies: Found shot
en.summary: The Deputy Governor of Afyonkarahisar and General Secretary of the Provincial Special Administration, İhsan Ayr, was found shot and killed.

stories.title: 20 yıl önce kaybolmuştu: eşi ve 6 çocuğu gözaltına alındı

en.title: Missing 20 years ago: his wife and 6 children detained
en.summary: Turkish authorities are investigating the fate of Rıza Güzel, who disappeared in Kırşehir in 2006. His wife and six children have been taken into custody as part of the investigation.

stories.title: TMSF, Destek Finans Faktoring'e kayyım olarak atandı

en.title: TMSF appointed as trustee for Destek Finans Faktoring
en.summary: The Savings Deposit Insurance Fund has been appointed as trustee for Destek Finans Faktoring A.Ş., the company announced through the Public Disclosure Platform.

stories.title: TMSF, Destek Finans Faktoring'e kayyum olarak atandı

en.title: TMSF appointed as trustee for Destek Finans Faktoring
en.summary: The Savings Deposit Insurance Fund has been appointed as trustee for Destek Finans Faktoring company following an investigation by the fund.

stories.title: Kerem Demirbay'dan gündem olan sözlerine ilişkin yeni açıklama!

en.title: New statement from Kerem Demirbay regarding his controversial remarks!
en.summary: Kasımpaşa midfielder Kerem Demirbay, who won two championships with Galatasaray, has clarified that his recent statements about the club were taken out of context.

stories.title: Aralarında gazetemiz yazarı Ağırel de var: 3 gazeteci 'şüpheli' sıfatıyla ifade verecek!

en.title: Among them is our newspaper's columnist: 3 journalists to give statements as 'suspects'
en.summary: The Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's Office announced that columnist Murat Ağırel and journalists İsmail Saymaz and Şaban Sevinç will be questioned as suspects. Detention orders were issued for Sözcü editor Mustafa Balcı and journalist Şaban Sevinç.

stories.title: 20 yıl önce kaybolmuştu: Rıza Güzel'in eşi ve 6 çocuğu gözaltına alındı

en.title: Missing 20 years ago: Wife and 6 children of Rıza Güzel detained
en.summary: Seven suspects including the wife and six children of Rıza Güzel, who disappeared in Kırşehir in 2006, were detained as part of an investigation. Bone fragments believed to belong to Güzel were discovered following confessions and site identifications by the suspects.

stories.title: Galatasaray sözleri gündem olmuştu: Kerem Demirbay'dan açıklama geldi!

en.title: Galatasaray remarks became topic of discussion: Statement from Kerem Demirbay
en.summary: Kasımpaşa midfielder Kerem Demirbay, 33, made comments about his time at Galatasaray. He issued a statement addressing remarks that drew criticism from yellow-red supporters.

stories.title: Polis memuru Ahmet Türkoğlu'nun şehit edilmesine ilişkin 5 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: 5 suspects arrested in connection with killing of police officer Ahmet Türkoğlu
en.summary: Five suspects were arrested following an incident in Ankara's Pursaklar district where a person in a stopped vehicle opened fire during a police operation, resulting in the death of police officer Ahmet Türkoğlu.

stories.title: Maltepe'deki enkazda 1 kişinin cansız bedenine ulaşıldı

en.title: One body found in rubble in Maltepe
en.summary: Search and rescue operations continue at a seven-story building that collapsed in Maltepe. The body of Mesut Bilecen, one of three people still being sought, has been recovered from the rubble.

stories.title: New York borsası karışık seyirle kapandı

en.title: New York stock exchange closed with mixed results
en.summary: The New York stock exchange ended the day with mixed performance, influenced by rising oil prices and declining technology sector shares.

en.title: Chasing tuna for two hours
en.summary: The 18th Big Fish Turkey championship in the Aegean featured 40 boats and nearly 200 competitors, with a 100-kilogram tuna determining the winner. Participants experience extended battles lasting hours while competing with sportsman-like conduct.

en.title: 'Ottoman traces in Rumelia' exhibition in Sarajevo
en.summary: An exhibition by Kuwait Turk titled 'Ottoman Traces in Rumelia' showcasing Ottoman heritage in the Balkan region opened to art enthusiasts in Sarajevo, the capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

en.title: Niğde Cuisine with Its Blue and Tortoise
en.summary: The Tabal Gastronomy House, established by Niğde Municipality, opened on the Bosphorus shore to present Niğde's culinary traditions to Istanbul diners under the direction of chef Duran Özdemir.
